summary.text: Dave Craven is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 29 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Judy H. Little.
He has served in the Senate since 2020 and chairs the Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Craven has served in the Senate since 2020, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly's website lists his district as covering Anson, Montgomery, Randolph, Richmond and Union counties.
He chairs the Finance Committee, serves as vice chair of the Revenue Laws Study Committee and co-chairs the Joint Legislative Economic Development and Global Engagement Oversight Committee.
The Republican primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
